assumptions.decision: projected_late thresholds v1: lateDays = abs(projectedDaysDelta); 1-3 -> floor low, 4-7 -> floor medium, 8+ -> floor high; only status active and projectionConfidence medium|high. Constants grouped in READING_GOAL_RISK.
assumptions.reason: Spec's recommended default; run prompt says use v1 defaults and flag them as new technical detail in the final report.

assumptions.decision: projected_late is excluded from the reason-count rule (levelMinimumReasons high:2/medium:1, constants.ts:36). riskLevel = max(level from the existing rules over the other reasons, forecast floor from A01). critical is never lowered and never produced by the forecast alone.
assumptions.reason: If projected_late counted as a reason, one reason already yields medium (risk.ts:131) and the spec's 1-3 days -> low row could never happen.

assumptions.decision: projected_late is appended as the last value of ReadingGoalRiskReasonSchema; riskReasons keep schema order (risk.ts:85), so the attention primary reason (attention.ts:145 riskReasons[0]) stays the pace/deadline reason when one exists.
assumptions.reason: Keeps existing attention messages stable; for the test goal projected_late is the only reason.

assumptions.decision: Existing hasLowRisk (risk.ts:103-115, 0<=delta<=3 on_track -> low) stays unchanged.
assumptions.reason: Spec forbids weakening existing rules; changing it alters current outputs not asked for.

assumptions.decision: needsReadingGoalAttention (attention.ts:28-38) is not edited: 8+ days -> high -> already included. toMessageData gets an explicit projected_late case carrying lateDays plus remainingCount/targetCount.
assumptions.reason: Today projected_late would fall into the pace-delta default branch (attention.ts:134-140) and the FE could not print the day count.

assumptions.decision: book_counted completedCount for an operation that newly counts n books and leaves C counted after it: ordinals C-n+1..C, new books ordered by finishedAt asc then bookId asc. One pure domain function used by sync.service countedRows and recorder countedRows (creation: base 0, so 1..n).
assumptions.reason: Matches 'скільки книг зараховано після цієї події'; book_uncounted in the same operation is already excluded from C.

assumptions.decision: Rows written by one createMany get strictly increasing createdAt in emission order (one captured now + addMilliseconds(index)); no schema change, ids stay uuid v4.
assumptions.reason: Today a batch shares now() (schema.prisma:728) and newest-first order falls back to random uuid v4 id desc (schema.prisma:722, activity.repository.ts:67), so 2/5 may render below 1/5.

assumptions.decision: Backfill = pure reconstruction function (domain) + script in apps/api/src/scripts with dry-run as default and an explicit --apply flag; idempotent; ambiguous ties (same createdAt, no deterministic order) logged and skipped; never wired into deploy or migrations; never executed by this task.
assumptions.reason: Spec requires a safe, idempotent, non-automatic procedure; backfill-thumbnails.ts + package.json script is the existing precedent.

assumptions.decision: One title helper: goal.name ?? compact 'Прочитати N книг' / 'Read N books' (no deadline). Used by header, catalog card, attention item (targetCount from messageData.targetCount, always set at attention.ts:116), best result, ListGoalCard, statistics reading-goal-card and reading-goal-dashboard. List name shown as its own line/link.
assumptions.reason: RG-03 asks for one FE function; statistics renders the same goal with yet another fallback (name ?? listName ?? 'N книги'); no contract change needed for attention.

assumptions.decision: Form name placeholder stays explanatory (goals.form.namePlaceholder).
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly allows it.

assumptions.decision: useForm mode onChange; Save disabled when !formState.isValid || isPending || (edit && unchanged); targetCount hint hidden while a targetCount error is shown.
assumptions.reason: Spec names formState.isValid with a matching validation mode; removes the duplicated 'У цілі 5 книг' / 'У цілі лише 5 книг'.

assumptions.decision: Plan marker (elapsedPercent) and 'План на сьогодні' legend render only for status active; completed/expired/archived show their status label instead.
assumptions.reason: A plan-for-today marker is meaningless after the goal is closed; spec: «До дедлайну» лише для active.

assumptions.decision: on_track with negative paceDeltaBooks gets an explanatory sentence (close to plan, small lag of X books vs expected Y) — text only, no new enum.

assumptions.decision: Next step: when riskLevel != none and requiredDaysPerBook != null show '≈1 книга кожні N днів'; otherwise a link to the Books tab scope=remaining.

assumptions.decision: Books grid: two columns from xl (>=1280px), one column below.

assumptions.decision: Chip counts come from the detail query already loaded: all = snapshotBookCount, counted = completedCount, remaining = max(snapshotBookCount - completedCount, 0). No new API.
assumptions.reason: Snapshot rows cascade-delete with the book (schema.prisma:711), so snapshotBookCount equals the scope=all row count.

assumptions.decision: Adopt: equal qualifiedFinishedAt -> snapshot position asc -> bookId asc in compareReadingGoalBooks. The same function drives sort and cursor (books.service.ts:106,135,250) and the cursor payload already carries position (:31), so the cursor format does not change. Domain compareQualifyingBooks (progress.ts:149) is not touched.
assumptions.reason: Spec's suggested default; zero cursor-format risk.

assumptions.decision: Minibar only when pagesCount > 0 and currentPage != null: percent = clamp(round(currentPage / pagesCount * 100), 0, 100) via the Progress primitive.
One-line summary plus the existing full explanation behind a disclosure (Collapsible or Popover primitive already in components/ui).
assumptions.reason: No new dependency.

assumptions.decision: Group flattened infinite pages by instantToIsoDay({ instant: createdAt, timeZone: useProfileTimeZone() }); event time formatted in the profile time zone.
assumptions.reason: Flattening merges same-day items across pages by construction; lib/iso-day.ts:10-17 already exists.

assumptions.decision: Old book_counted metadata is rendered as stored; FE never recomputes it.
assumptions.reason: Spec forbids substituting current progress into history.

assumptions.decision: Completed state uses goal-completed-trophy-books.png, not statistics/progress/goal-tea-books.png.
assumptions.reason: F4 calls tea-books only a candidate; the v3 F-Assets block and 04 map bind the trophy.

assumptions.decision: Trophy is NOT added to the «Найкращий результат» card.
assumptions.reason: D10 and F-Assets forbid illustrations on populated cards; 'за можливості' is not a requirement.

assumptions.decision: Full empty states via EmptyState illuSize sm (224px, inside 160-240); compact blocks (forecast insufficient, completed hero, expired hero) via a small presentational image 96-128px with explicit natural-ratio width/height and alt=''. EmptyStateIllustration union gains 'reading-goals/goal-first-goal-empty-state' and 'reading-goals/goal-no-counted-books-yet'.
assumptions.reason: Minimal extension of the tested EmptyState; compact blocks are not empty states.

assumptions.decision: Hourglass only when goal.status === 'expired'; archived goals with result expired get no hourglass; active goals with projected_late never get it.
assumptions.reason: expired != projected late; archived is its own status.

assumptions.decision: Below sm: Edit button + DropdownMenu trigger '⋯' (aria-label) holding Archive/Delete; from sm: inline buttons. Focus returns to the ⋯ trigger after a dialog closes.
assumptions.reason: D09; existing opener refs (goal-detail-actions.tsx:40-42) cover the inline case.
